Also a hip to gable rear alteration to the existing roof to allow for an En-Suite with in the loft room, with rear facing window. A new stair case from first floor landing winding over existing stair case. All external materials to match existing. Please see attached drawings for more information.--- Status: INV--- Decision: --- Date Decision Issued: ---
